blind.description: A stylized fantasy stone wall section featuring a central arched portal. The structure consists of heavy dark grey stone blocks framing an inner pointed archway, filled in with smaller rough fieldstones and mossy green weathering near the base. Inside the top of the archway hangs the lower edge of a raised wooden portcullis gate with sharp iron-capped spikes. The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized with no floating pieces or corrupted mesh.
blind.from_above: A straight, narrow rectangular row of rounded rectangular stone capstones aligned horizontally, with the shadow projecting an archway and jagged portcullis teeth onto the ground.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 8 to 9 feet wide.
